opportunities.title: William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants
opportunities.summary: Grants for the conservation of church buildings and their contents. Two application rounds each year (31 March and 31 August). No references required.

opportunities.title: Linda Parry Textile Conservation and Research Grants
opportunities.summary: Grants for textile conservation and research. Applications are made via the William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants form; no references are required.

opportunities.title: Hugh Phillips Research Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator; early career researchers welcome; no work contributing to a degree; no retrospective applications.
opportunities.summary: Annual project grant of £500-£5,000 for research into the human past through its material culture or material remains (Britain pre-1800 focus).

opportunities.title: Margaret and Tom Jones Memorial Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator; no work contributing to a degree; no retrospective applications.
opportunities.summary: Annual project grant of £500-£5,000 for research into the human past through its material culture or material remains. Two references required.

opportunities.title: Wainwright Research Archaeology in Wales Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator; no work contributing to a degree; no retrospective applications.
opportunities.summary: Annual project grant of £500-£5,000 for archaeological research in Wales.

opportunities.title: Open Research Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator; no work contributing to a degree; no retrospective applications.
opportunities.summary: Annual open project grant of £500-£5,000 for research into the human past through its material culture or material remains, open across the full range of the Society's remit.

opportunities.title: Beatrice de Cardi Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator; no work contributing to a degree; no retrospective applications.
opportunities.summary: Annual award for research into the archaeology of the Arabian Peninsula / Middle East. Two references required. Extended reporting deadline applies.

opportunities.title: Janet Arnold Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator; no work contributing to a degree; no retrospective applications.
opportunities.summary: Annual award for research on dress and textiles (dress history / textile studies).

opportunities.title: Tessa and Mortimer Wheeler Travel Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator.
opportunities.summary: Annual travel awards for archaeological fieldwork training / travel, with reduced reporting requirements.

opportunities.title: William Lambarde Memorial Travel Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator.
opportunities.summary: Annual travel awards for researchers whose funds are primarily for their own research travel. Reduced reporting requirements.
